column1: Database from Kaggle:
Retail Store Inventory and Demand Forecasting:
https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/atomicd/retail-store-inventory-and-demand-forecasting/code
Columns and their meaning:
1. Date: Date of the record.
2. Store ID: Unique identifier for the store.
3. Product ID: Unique identifier for the product.
4. Category: Product category.
5. Region: Geographical region of the store.
6. Inventory Level: Units in stock at the beginning of the day.
7. Units Sold: Units sold on that day.
8. Units Ordered: Units ordered for restocking.
9. Price: Product price.
10. Discount: Discount applied
11. Weather Condition: Weather on the day of the record.
12. Promotion: 1 if there was a promotion
13. Competitor Pricing: Price of a similar product from a competitor.
14. Seasonality: Season (e.g.
15. Epidemic: 1 if an epidemic occurred
16. Demand: Daily estimated demand for the product
